title: Frequency-addressed state-dependent operator composition
summary: This pass narrows the FANMC / NotSoSimpleNeuron thread to a stronger executable condition: an address must select resident structure, local persistent state must change the operator encountered by the next event, and A→B must differ from B→A after fast state has settled away. v0 isolates the mechanism in reduced resonators. v1 re-embodies it in heterogeneous quasi-active cable branches. v2 factorizes morphology from quasi-active kinetics and kills the strong 'cable length carries the spectral address' reading: geometry-only never exceeds 1.205 raw address rank or 1.878 after branch-gain normalization, while kinetic heterogeneity alone at equal branch length retains rank 4.000. v3 then removes cable geometry entirely. A non-geometric 32-mode adaptive state-space system with the exact same 96-real-state budget reproduces the gate, and a 12-real-state four-mode system still crosses the weaker multi-address gate. The surviving object is therefore separated resident modes plus local persistent state that causally rewrites the later operator, not cable substrate as such.

nodes.claim: Tests whether frequency can select resident modal/cable structure whose local persistent state rewrites the operator encountered by later packets, making addressed operator composition noncommutative after fast state has decayed.
nodes.survived: v0 passes a reduced-resonator gate with address rank 3.443, written-operator rank 3.078, commutator ratio 0.564 and paired order/jitter 3.374x. v1 re-embodies the mechanism in heterogeneous quasi-active cable branches: address rank 3.977, written-operator rank 2.581, material-write rank 2.904 and order/jitter 3.602x. v2 shows kinetic heterogeneity carries the spectral address while morphology enriches the written-operator family. v3 removes geometry completely: a matched 96-real-state modal SSM reaches address rank 3.187, written-operator rank 3.306, commutator ratio 0.616 and order/jitter 4.903x; across eight seeds its address rank is 3.177–3.307 with median written-operator rank 2.835. A compact 12-real-state modal SSM reaches address rank 2.522 and written-operator rank 2.998.
nodes.killed: Order dependence alone is insufficient; homogeneous or geometry-only systems can remain strongly path-dependent while address rank collapses. v2 kills the idea that cable length alone carries the address in the tested interface. v3 kills cable specificity more broadly under the current gate: a non-geometric modal state-space system reproduces the addressed persistent noncommuting operator family at an equal state budget, and a much smaller 12-state system already passes a weaker multi-address threshold. This does not show that arbitrary dense RNNs automatically discover the mechanism. The unresolved boundary is explicit spectral/modal structure versus unstructured recurrence, and possibly parameter/learning efficiency rather than substrate identity.

edges.why: The new repository takes FANMC's frequency-as-external-address result and asks the stricter question FANMC left open: whether the addressed event changes a resident operator so that later operator composition becomes order-dependent, rather than merely writing a persistent code.

NotSoSimpleNeuron established the receiver-side idea that resident active state changes what the next event encounters. This repository isolates that idea as an explicit noncommuting operator-composition gate and then re-embodies it in quasi-active cable branches.

InformationFlow made frequency and phase external coordinates for selecting interactions that write persistent routing state. The new experiment keeps frequency as an address but moves the consequence into a resident operator whose later composition is explicitly tested for order.

Operaattori supplies the structural-compiler view in which morphology generates an executable transport/nonlinear operator. The new repository studies the complementary runtime question: whether addressed local state can rewrite such an operator between events.

ArtificialCortex previously treated space, frequency and phase as coordinates of resident dynamical tissue. The new repository turns that broad architectural intuition into a much narrower controlled operator-composition experiment.

motifs.title: Addressing becomes computationally stronger when the first event rewrites the operator seen by the second
motifs.description: Frequency filtering, persistent memory and order dependence are each weaker than the combined object. The surviving condition is: different addresses excite different resident structure; the resulting local state causally changes the later operator; and compositions do not commute after fast transients have vanished. v2 shows that quasi-active kinetic diversity, not cable length by itself, carries the strong spectral address in the synthetic cable. v3 goes further: the same gate is reproduced by a non-geometric modal state-space system at the exact same state budget, and partly by a 12-state version. The substrate-independent core is therefore separated resident modes aligned with local state-dependent operator rewrite. The next unresolved boundary is whether that modal structure must be supplied explicitly or can emerge in an unstructured recurrent system under matched resources.
